tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur mgon lha brgyad kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa gzi brjid stobs 'bar ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(404)༄༅// he ru ka dpal thugs las sprul// bstan srung rgyal po myur mgyogs kyi// pho nyar bcas pas bdag skyongs la// chos ldan bsam sbyor gegs med mdzod// rdo rje gur gyi rgyud chen po las gsungs pa'i dpal mgon po lcam dral las byed dang bcas pa lha brgyad du grags pa'i gtor chog dang rjes gnang mdor bsdus bkod pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ bla med kyi dbang bskur thob pa'i slob ma la/ nyer dgu la sogs pa'i dus khyad par can la/ yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ mgon po'i bris sku bkram/ rten gtor gru gsum nor gzugs ma mañdzi'i steng du bkod/ de las cung dma' bar rtag gtor zur brgyad 'bul gtor mdun du bsham/ mchod pa ci bder bsgrigs/ maṇḍal chos 'byung gru gsum dbus su gtor ma 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod/ gtor chog kho na byed skabs/ rang gi mdun tu stegs bu mtho ba la yi dam dang*/ mgon po'i gtor ma kha zas bzang dgu las bcos pa/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa bzhag de'i mdun tu stegs cung dma' bar rtag gtor zur brgyad 'bul gtor sha khrag mchod pa dang bcas pa bkod/ sngon gtor sogs nyer mkho gzhan yang tshogs bar bya'o// gnyis pa la dang po sgrub thabs ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo dang*/(405)nang mchod byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed dgyes rdor gtsor gyur he ru ka'i rigs sam/ phyag rdor lta bu khro bo'i rgyal po gang yang rung ba'i bskyed bzlas bsdu ldangs bcas sngon tu 'gro bas/ mchod gtor yi dam gang byed de nyid kyi cho ga ltar ram/ bla med spyi 'gro'i byin rlabs bsdus pa gang 'dod bya/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus na dgra bgegs mnan pa'i steng du paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/

dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po dus kyi mun pa lta bu'i sku mdog can che zhing cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis car gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam (406)po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i bsham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyis cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag /rgyab na lcags spyang*/ mdun na mi nag /steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khor las byed sprul ba yang sprul sde brgyad kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o// de'i g.yon tu trag las e ka dzā ṭi sku mdog sngon mo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon tu 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bhyoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog sngo nag /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang por ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa// glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/

ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa spyan gsum dang ldan shing*/ mi ro rengs pa khar (407)bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid cing lte ba'i thang ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bhyo'i sgra sgrog pa/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang*/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas ma mdun du spros pa las/ ya las nag po gnod sbyin g.yas gri gug phyar zhing*/ g.yon sbar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas nyi ma 'char ba/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon cing gser gyi rna cha can/ de'i g.yon tu maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/ g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas zla ba 'char ba/ dar nag gi na bza' dang bye ru'i lan tshar can/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas yab las tri gnyis dang*/ yum las bhyo gcig spros pa las/ bu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ de dag gi mdun du 'khod pa ni/ tri las pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shang lang gi gri ring 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa klad khrag dron mos gang ba 'dzin cing zhal du gsol ba/ mon kri'i ga zha dang*// dar nag gi na bza' can/ tri las bha tra nag po dar gyi ga zha dang*/ stag slag gyon pa/ g.yas dam shing dang*/ g.yon mi snying 'dzin cing gsol ba/ bhyo las sring mo ral gcig ma/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/ g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin cing*/ mig nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga car yang sku mdog mthing nag /mon bu pho mo'i cha lugs can/ mi mgo'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ rab tu khros la rngam zhing 'khrugs pas/ gdug (408)pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na 'gying ba'o// de'i mtha' skor du/

g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa'i skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba bandhe nag po phur thogs brgya/ mdun gyi bshul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya// gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag ce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drangs bar mos/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ mgon po lcam dral gnas 'dir gshegs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā ka la ya ma hā kā lī de bī e hya hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi spo dang*/ bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can rnams nas/ las mgon pu tra 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ las mgon sku gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ sogs gong ltar/ a li a li ma dzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi de da a shwa de da/ mu smug pu tra a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la ru pa dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bhyo dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pho mo'i 'bod sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ e hye hiḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā (409)kā li de wī ehya hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma la ya st+waṃ/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā ka li de bi ye gṛ hṇi daṃ ārghaṃ swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ tha la mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam tshig phyag rgya/ thal mo'i sor mo rtse mo bsnol ba lha mo'i dam rgya'o//

oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ sa ma ya smar sa ma ya/ ma ti kra me ye/ sa ma ya/ rakṣantu/ yang*/ a li a li sogs pho mo'i 'bod sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ sa ma ya sma ra sogs btags pa brjod pas dam bzhag bya/ phrin bcol ni/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang*/ bsgrad cing gzir ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ sdigs shing spa skong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin tu 'grub cing*/ bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ gtor 'bul ni/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ (410)ma hā kā li de wī ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te/ spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis lcam dral dang*/ 'bod sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis las mgon la 'bul/ gong ltar mchod/ phud gtor zhing*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi e ṣa a pashtsi ma kā lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ/ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi/ ya di pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/

i daṃ duṣṭaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra mā ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bhandha bhandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha ba tau si ka ma la rākṣa si hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ 'bod sngags gnyis la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jig byed pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che// gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas// g.yon pas gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod// thod phreng can la bdag bstod do// khros pa'i zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo// 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel// dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa/ dam tshig can la bdag bstod do// dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ya// lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che// ma hā de ba'i sras po drag shul can// tshogs bdag chen po ma hā kā la ya/ legs ldan nag po grong khyer gsum brtsegs dgra /bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che// chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che// dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po che// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha (411)khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dzam bu dwī pa'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul// da bcol las kyi gsal 'debs gnyan por bzhes// 'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs// bdud dang bar du gcod byed rnam mang po// thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bstan pa rgyas pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs// zhes dang*/ bhyoḥ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus// 'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas// 'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku// ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid// dbang po sngon po lta bu 'bar// nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug

/mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs// khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*// 'jigs pa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams brel// mi mgo rin chen rus pas sbrel// klu rnams seng ge lcags sgrog dang*// khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan// ko rlon re lde gos su gyon// bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu// shin tu rid cing mi sdug ma// 'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs// 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra sgrog pas// khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas// sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud// khyed thugs zhi la ngang gzhol yang*// snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs// khro dang 'khrugs dang rngam pa (412)yis// bdud dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud// dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /'dir gshegs sogs kyis bstod cing phrin las gzhol// las mgon la/ /gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs// rngam zhing 'khrugs pa'i cha lugs kyis// bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa'i// bstan bsrung yab yum che la bstod/ mon bu pu tra nag po bskyod/ mon kri'i ga zha sku la gsol// sher shing gseg shang phyag na bsnams// pu tra nag po khyod la bstod// mon bu bha tra stag slag bkra// dar gyi ga zha sku la gsol// phyag na dam shing rnon po bsnams// mon bu bha tra khyod la bstod// mon mo gser gyi spu gri ma// nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma// phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams// nag mo khyod la bdag bstod do// bud med nag mo chen mo brgya// gshegs kyi de ni bshul yang 'dren// g.yas kyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa// skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya// g.yon gyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa// dge slong nyan thos dgra bcom brgya// slad kyis rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba// bandhe nag po phur thogs brgya// 'khor bcas rnams la bstod pa 'bul// skabs gsum bdag kyang bstod pa 'bul//

zhes pa'am/ spro na bstod pa rgyas pa bya zhing*/ shin tu bsdu na/ /dpal ldan phrin las kun rdzogs pu tra khyod// sku mdog mthing nag me yi 'phro 'du can// rngam pa'i stabs kyis 'gying zhing shang lang bsnams// gying chen gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod// ces pa gcig pus kyang chog go / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs phrin las bcol/ gtor chog la de tsam gyis 'thus/ rjes gnang la skabs 'dir slob ma'i (413)rgyud byin gyis rlobs pa'i don du bzlas pa ci 'grub bya ste// de'ang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po/ shā sa na rtsa sngags te de ltar gsum dang*/ lha mo'i snying po/ /oṃ ro ru sogs dang*/ las mgon gyi 'bod sngags gnyis ci rigs pa bzla/ de rjes mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs kyang btang ngo*// de nas rjes su gnang ba la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma khrus sngon tu 'gro bas phyag bya/ gral la 'khod/ mchod g.yog pas me tog bkram zhing phyed bsdus la maṇḍal dbul zhing*/ phyid slob ma'i snyim bar me tog dang cas las 'dug pa la/ slob dpon gyis/

sems can gyi don du sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad bsal ba'i phyir/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba zhu snyam pa'i 'dun pa sngon du btang 'tshal/ de yang 'phags ma mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i le'u bco lnga pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa las byung zhing*/ bram ze mchog sred la sogs pa'i grub pa thob pa rnams las brgyud de/ dpal sa skya pa khu dbon la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis brgyan te/ phyag len dang thugs dam mdzad pa'i dpal nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la dbang bskur dang rjes gnang rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa mang du yod cing*/ rjes gnang la'ang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa phyag mtshan gtod pa gnyis su yod pa las phyi ma dang po sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas 'dir de nyid bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par bya ba/ byin rlabs ldan pa'i rjes gnang dngos/ slob dpon gyi rjes bsdu ba'i rim pa rnams so// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang mchod pa'o// gnyis pa rjes su gnang ba la/ sngon du (414)'gro ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gi chos gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro la lnga/ maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab pa/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba/ byin rlabs kyi lus kyi gzhi sprul pa'o// dang po la/ thog mar maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob mas maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam 'joms pa// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/

gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ khyod zhabs padmo spang nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis// blo mchog bdag la snang bar mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ gnyis pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa ni/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// ces sogs bya ba nas/ gsum pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig byas la/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// ces bya ba la sogs pa lan gsum bya/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma dam pa rin po ches bdag la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ ces (415)lan gsum/ lnga pa byin rlabs kyis lus gzhi sprul pa la dmigs pa 'di rnams rtse gcig tu sgoms shig /slob dpon bcom 'das kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug /zhabs bzhi pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par skyor ba yin snyam du mos/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bla ma brgyud pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mdun na yod pa'i gtor ma dang*/ sku 'di dag dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma ro'i steng na gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ de'i g.yon tu e ka dzā ṭi/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ de dag gi mdun tu nag po gnod sbyin yab yum/ de'i mdun tu pu tra ming sring gsum/ ru 'dren pho nya bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong*/

zhing skyong*/ mkha' 'gro/ sha za/ lha srin sde brgyad// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ sprul pa 'bum dang yang sprul bye ba/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams sku gzi brjid phun sum tshogs shing*/ gsung hūm̐ dang bhyo'i sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs shing*/ thugs bde gsal gyi ngang las bstan pa bsrung ba'i las la brtson par mngon sum du mdun 'di na bzhugs snyam du mos pa byed 'tshal/ de nas bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung*/ mdun bskyed chos skyong gi thugs kar phog /thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ sngon po gcig 'phros/ shangs nas thon te khyed rang rnam pa'i (416)lus la g.yas bskor du lan gsum bskor nas kha nas zhugs/ snying gar snyi ma'i gdan gcig bsam pa'i steng du gnas/ de las 'od 'phros/ las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad dang*/ rnam smin gyi phung po chen po ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ hūm̐ de yang zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo thig le la thim/ thig le na da la thim/ da me long la has btab pa bzhin yal nas spros pa thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las dgra bgegs mnan pa'i steng du paṃ las padma sogs 'og gi mngon rtogs ltar la/ yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rdo rje nag po chen po sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gsal thob cig /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de lta bu'i sngon 'gro sngon tu song nas/ rjes gnang dngos la gsum/ sku'i rjes gnang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang*/ thugs kyi rjes gnang dang gsum du yod pa las thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku rdo rje// da lta nyid du bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ mos gus khyad par can byas pas/ bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/

mdun gyi chos skyong la phog ste thugs rgyud bskul bas// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku dpag tu med pa dang*/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho'i thugs ka nas kyang chos skyong gi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs pa che ba ri rab tsam dang chung ba til gyi 'bru tsam pa 'od zer du ma 'phro zhing hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa byon/ khyed rang rnam pa'i smin mtshams dang*/ (417)lus kyi stod smad bar gsum du thim// yang 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang rdo rje gdan gyi spo// bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can rnams nas nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang pu tra ming sring gsum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs la/ mgon po lcam dral bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i sku'i rnam par gyur nas char chen po babs pa bzhin lus la thim par mos pa byos shig / ces brjod la/ gu gul dang*/ mgon po'i spos kyi dud pa dang*/ āṣṭas thog drangs pa'i snying po dang*/ shā sa na dang*/ ro ru 'bod sngags gnyis lan gsum gsum brjod cing rol mo dkrol la/ drag tu byin dbab/ des sku'i rjes gnang grub/ ces brjod/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung rdo rje// da lta nyid du bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum/ bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi gseb na/ nye snying dang snying po dang rtsa sngags yod par mos/ mdun bskyed kyi nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i mthar oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces nye snying dang*/ de'i phyi ru/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po dang de'i phyi ru/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya shā sa na sogs rtsa sngags tshang ba brjod/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rtsa sngags dang*/ de'i phyi nas/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha ba to si ka ma la rakṣa si hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes lha mo'i sngags rnams kyis (418)bskor nas yod par bsam/ khyed rang rnams kyang chos skyong du dmigs pa'i snying padma 'dab brgyad ltar kha bye ba'i nang du/ paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ zhu ba las rdo rje sngon po lte bar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gcig bsam/ de nas mos gus byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nag po chen po la phog pas de'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba sgra dang bcas pa gcig las gcig chad zhal nas thon/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar 'khod/ la la hūm̐ la thim/ yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho'i thugs ka nas kyang rtsa sngags snying po rab tu 'bar zhing 'brug gi sgra ltar skad sgrog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ gzhan yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung yig 'bru'i rnam pa ā li kā li'i sngags bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs pa'ang khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang sngags rnams la thim/ dud pa dang lha sngags kyi thog drangs pa'i sngags lan gsum gyi bar la rol mo dang*/ dmigs pas drag tu dbab/ da khyed rang rnams pa phreng ba'am/ me tog re lag tu bzung*/ rjes su bzlas pas lung blang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis/ mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i sngags rnams re re las mar me gcig las gcig chad pa'i tshul du sgra 'od dang bcas pas zhal nas thon/

khyed rang rnam pa'i zhal du zhugs// thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar nye snying dang*/ snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags dang*/ lha mo'i sngags rnams phyi rim du 'khod cing 'khor/ yang mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis las (419)mgon rnams bskul te/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung*/ lcam dral kyi sngags kyi mthar 'khod par bsgoms la/ rjes zlos lan gsum bgyis pa'i dang po dam tshig pa'i tshul dang*/ gnyis pa ye shes pa'i rnam pa/ gsum pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa shin tu brtan pa'i tshul gyis thim par bsam la sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod cig / byas la gong gi mgon po'i sngags gsum dang*/ lha mo'i sngags rnams rim par lan gsum gsum rjes zlas byar gzhug /de nas las mgon sngags/ a li a li ma dzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded a shwa ded/ mu smugs pu tra a li ma dza dzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dza dzaḥ pho'i 'bod pa'o// dhrig dhrig /ya du pa sha ni sod/ dum shig ā ga tsa/ mon bu ā gatstsha// ya ṇir ya ṇir mon bu dza/ mon bu khrag 'jibs/ ṇir rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/ shag shig rbad/ tri ta rbad/ tri ta rbad/ mon bu pu tra shaṃ rbad/ yaṃ rmugs liṃ 'dus/ khaṃ shod pa ya mo dzaḥ a mu ka'i rus pa la khrol khrol rbad/ gser gyi spu gri yaṃ rbad/ bsad pa'o// oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsi pa la/ a shugme ma hūm̐ ma bhyo dza dza/ mo'i 'bod pa'o/ /traka rakṣa kha mun tra ru lu ru lu/ rakṣa snying khrag snying bhyoḥ spu ta spu ta bhyo/ sha sha traka /tra pa snying khrag /trakmu tra che ge mo mā ra ya/ rbad pa'o// oṃ ma hā rakṣa tsitta/ srog tuṃ tuṃ/ ka ma la rakṣa tsitta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ gu hya rakṣa tsitta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ hri baṃ rakṣa tsitta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ ma ma tsa bur tsitta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ pu ru tsa lhuṃ tsitta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ bsad pa ste de rnams kyang gsum re'o// 'dir 'bod sngags gnyis las rbad bsad rjes zlos ma byas kyang chog pa tsam yin gsung*/

de ltar lung nod zin nas/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /mgon po bdag la stsal lags kyis// mgon po (420)bdag la byin gyis rlobs// ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag / mgon po 'di la stsal lags kyis// mgon po 'di la byin gyis rlobs// ces lan gsum/ des gsung gi rjes gnang grub pa lags// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba btab pa'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rdo rje// da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/ ces lan gsum/ mos gus byas pas// bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun gyi nag po chen po lcam dral la phog pas/ de'i thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ gri gug /thod khrag /ral gri/ mdung thung*/ rtse gsum/ shang lang*/ dam shing*/ gser gyi spu gri la sogs pa gtso 'khor rnams kyi phyag mtshan sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer 'bar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa rnams thugs ka'i rdo rje dang sa bon la sib sib thim/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byon/ 'od du zhu nas thugs kar thim/ dud pa dang rtsa sngags kyis thog drangs pa'i sngags lan gsum gyi bar la rol mo byas la dbab/ des thugs kyi rjes gnang grub/ de nas khyed rang rnams pa'i snying padma 'dab brgyad ltar yod pa de dag kha zum nas de'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas rgyas btab pas/ bdag nyid la brtan par bzhugs nas grogs mdzad par mos shig / ces byas la/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ tiṣṭha badzra lan gnyis brjod/ gsum pa mjug gi chos la bzhi/ phrin las kyi bka' bsgo ba/ sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa/ mi 'bral zhing gsang bar gdams pa/

maṇḍal dbul zhing dam tshig khas blangs pas bzung ba'o// de la (421)dang po phrin las kyi bka' bsgo ba'i slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ ces byas la/ gtor ma la dpal 'bar gcig btsug /slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ gtor ma 'di dpal nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod mngag pa dang bcas pa sprin gtibs pa bzhin tu bsam/ mgon po'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa bzhugs par mos pa mdzod cig / ces byas la/ dud pa byas shing*/ snying po dang*/ gzungs ring dang*/ lha mo'i sngags dang*/ pu tra'i 'bod sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ sa ma ye/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ shraddha ka ra warm+ma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo blo gros grags pa/ dpal sa skya la gong ma rnam lnga/ dam pa kun dga' grags pa la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dam tshig gi rim pa rnams las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di zhes bgyi ba ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad las srungs shig /mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sol cig /mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs shig /spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i dgra dang bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad thul la bsrung ba dang bskyab par gyis shig /rig (422)pa 'dzin pa 'di'i chos dang mthun pa'i ji ltar bka' bsgo ba bzhin khyed rnams kyis sgrubs shig /

ces brjod/ de nas yul khyad par can de rnams la dad gus byas la/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gror bcas pa 'od du zhu/ nag po chen po la thim/ de las 'od 'phros lha mo bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas 'od du zhu/ tshur 'dus nas nag po chen po la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu/ khyed rang gi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ khyed rang dang gnyis su med par gyur pas nus mthu phun sum tshogs par bsam/ rol mo mdzad do// gnyis pa sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ chos skyong 'di nyid la tshogs bdag gi tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa/ gshin rje ltar sgrub pa/ gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa dang bzhi bdog /bka' sdod kyi lugs la pho rkyang du sgrub pa/ mo rkyang du sgrub pa/ yab yum sbrags te sgrug pa gsum yod/ de ltar sgrub lugs de dag thams cad la'ang*/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las la sbyor ba gsum gyi man ngag yod pa dag skabs su sbyin gyi nyams su len pa la dbang ba yin no// gsum pa mi 'bral zhing gsang bar gdams pa ni/ de ltar rjes gnang lung sbyin pa'i dbang gis bsrung skyob byed/ lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis 'khor ba chos nyid yin/ khyed rang rnam pa dam tshig rnam dag bsrungs te/ gtor ma dang tshogs la brtson par mdzod/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi snod du ma gyur pa rnams la dpal mgon po 'khor bcas kyi mtshan tsam yang bstan pa bya ba ma yin no// bzhi pa maṇḍal dbul zhing*/ dam tshig khas blangs (423)pa bzung ba ni/ maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug / des maṇḍal bul nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// lan gsum/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol// ces lan gsum/

des rjes gnang grub pa lags/ zhes brjod/ bsod nams 'di yis= sogs smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya kā li de bī sa pa ri bā ra gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ sogs phyi mchod dang*/ snying po re mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dang*/ srin po'i gzugs kyis= sogs sha lo ka gsum dang*/ gang gi sku gsung= sogs sha lo ka gcig / dpal ldan phrin las rdzogs= sogs kyis bstod/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ bar chad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan mang du brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don kun= sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri bā ra ya hi gatstsha/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ badzra muḥs/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o// 'di la thun mong ma yin pa phyag mtshan sbyin pa la sogs pa'i 'dogs dang bcas pa ni/ dam pa kun dga' grags kyi yi ge las shes par bya'o// gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi// srog shing brtan por bzung ba dang*// nag po'i phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i// phrin las stobs su 'bar gyur cig /ces gangs can sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi srid srol gces par btus pa gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod las/ gsung ngag lam 'bras (424)bu dang bcas pa'i bka'i srung ma khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rabs las khol phyung bklags chog gi tshul du karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am/ blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang gi sgrub khang du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/// /
